Seerat, the eldest Monga sister, is pampered by her mother, Santosh, for her beauty. Santosh dreams of getting Seerat married to a rich man. As fate would have it, Angad falls in love with Seerat. programme.title: Fight Back To School 3
programme.desc: Police officer Chow Sing Sing is assigned to work undercover investigating the murder of millionaire Million Wong, to whom Chow has an uncanny resemblance, by posing as an amnesiac Wong.

programme.title: Kowloon Walled City
programme.desc: Neng was a street fighter who decides to life in Hong Kong's Kowloon Walled City. He is implicated in the fights and conspiracies. When his friend is hunted down by the triad, Neng must save his friend.

programme.title: Girl With The Diamond Slipper
programme.desc: Girl With The Diamond Slipper

programme.title: Bangkok Storm
programme.desc: Underground boxer Lin Feng is hunted by the Bangkok triad when he refuses to fight in an illegal match. He escaped successfully but lost his memory.

programme.title: Hong Kong, Hong Kong
programme.desc: A story of the illegal immigrant experience of people from the mainland of China who have made it to Hong Kong for a better life.

programme.title: Skyline Cruisers
programme.desc: Action adventure in which the formula for a cancer-curing medicine is stolen, and a kung-fu fighting team must overcome rivals and doublecrosses in order to get it back

programme.title: Doubles Cause Troubles
programme.desc: Two squabbling cousins find themselves in more trouble than they can imagine after their tenant ends up dead. The gangsters and the police are both after them, and they have no idea what they have done wrong!

programme.title: Chinese Odyssey: Pandora's Box
programme.desc: A Monkey King is reincarnated in the un human form as Joker, a highwayman oblivious to his original identity and the fact that 500 years earlier, he and his master, the Longevity Monk, were punished and made to stay human.

programme.title: The Accidental Spy
programme.desc: At a Hong Kong shopping center, Buck Yuen's (Jackie Chan's) intuition warns him. He saves a robbery's loot and gets on television, ends up in Istanbul via South Korea, and accidentally becomes a spy. Fortunately, he knows Kung Fu.

programme.title: Maybe It's Love
programme.desc: 10 year-old Marbles witness the murder of a young woman.

programme.title: Drunken Master
programme.desc: Wong Fei-Hung is a mischievous, yet righteous young man, but after a series of incidents, his frustrated father has him disciplined by a master of drunken martial arts.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: An actor tries to convince a lady to play Samantha in an adaptation of the classic TV series, but unbeknownst to him, she really is a witch!

programme.title: The Flying Mr. B
programme.desc: The Flying Mr. B

programme.title: Green Wood Robbery
programme.desc: Set in the early years of the Republic of China, the wealthy Kang family is brutally murdered, and their young daughter-the sole witness-mysteriously disappears.

programme.title: The Fate Of Reunion
programme.desc: Thousands of years ago, Green Snake gained enlightenment under the guidance of Dao Qing and gradually falls for him. However, her devotion to Dao Qing caused him to reincarnate and go through the pains of death.

programme.title: Get In The Dark
programme.desc: Miss Qiao had died in vain and her butler paid a paper craftsman to make a paper doll. Miss Qiao's spirit is revived to take revenge and a series of horrible events begins to happen.

programme.title: The Story Of My Son
programme.desc: Li Tsu-liang is newly widowed and leading an impoverished life with two young sons. He attempts to make a fortune at the horse-racing track, but is subsequently entangled with the loan sharks.

programme.title: Flying Swords Of Dragon Gate
programme.desc: Set three years after Dragon Inn, innkeeper Jade has disappeared and a new inn has risen from the ashes - one that's staffed by marauders masquerading as law-abiding citizens, who hope to unearth the fabled lost city buried in the desert.

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man
programme.desc: A rich playboy gets blown up by a gangster when he flirts with the gangster's wife. Through a series of circumstances, his professor makes him a synthetic body that allows him to change into anything he wants.

programme.title: Maoshan Heavenly Master
programme.desc: Prisoner Chi flees away under Master Zhang's custody, causing the latter to be expelled from his clan. Master Zhang arrives at a place where many people vanish and discovers that it is Chi who captures them.

programme.title: The Mighty Peking Man
programme.desc: A greedy Hong Kong businessman hires a young hunter to capture a giant gorilla said to live deep in the Indian jungle. The hunter finds the ape, and living with it he finds a feral human female who has befriended the creature.

programme.title: The Macaque Monkey
programme.desc: The world is in chaos after the tree of life was burnt. Sun Wu Kong decides to return to the past to resurrect it, but his divine power is unstable after losing the golden hoop.

programme.title: Legend Of The Fist: Chen Zhen
programme.desc: The year is 1917 and Chen Zhen, believed to be dead, returns to Shanghai under a false name. He joins a mob boss for info on the Japanese incl. a long kill list and at night fights the Japanese masked.

programme.title: Mahjong Heroes
programme.desc: A hero helps a young student deflect a cunning and malicious gambling tycoon who is out to take over the student’s family business over a game of mahjong.

programme.title: Mr. Vampire 2
programme.desc: Grave robbers unearth preserved vampires. Transporting child vampire, its spell breaks, befriending locals. Parent vampires awaken, escape. Herbalist pursues to destroy them.

programme.title: Confession Of Pain
programme.desc: A detective helps a friend investigate the mysterious death of his father-in-law.

programme.title: A Man Called Hero
programme.desc: Hero Wah goes to study under Master Pride. When he returns to his parents, he learns that they have been murdered by a band of evil Westerners. After impregnating his wife Jade, he ventures to New York in search of his parents' killers.

programme.title: Fate Jealous Greed
programme.desc: A man received a haunted mail predicting his death. A man mourns the death of his beloved wife. Three brothers clashes over dinner.

programme.title: Wusong Vs Ximenqing
programme.desc: Wu Song finds out about his sister-in-law's affair with a rich man, Ximen Qing. Qing sets Song up and have him exiled for a year, during which his hapless brother is murdered. Can he avenges his brother's death?

programme.title: Mid-Night Two
programme.desc: The film tells the story of a group of people in order to search for treasure, traveled thousands of miles to the ancient legend of the ghost mountain, for thousands of years whoever have entered the ghost mountain all disappeared, it is said that the mountain buried a female body never decomposed, the Yin fire didn't extinguished in thousand of years, every 2:30 in the morning the Yin fire is the heaviest, all the ghosts would return.

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: The Grey Men
programme.desc: The film's story unfolds in the fictional country of Laika and in Hong Kong, China. A police academy student who has not yet graduated, Ashan (played by Gu Bin), is tasked with a dangerous mission. He helps the criminal organization by eliminating obstacles for their leader, Atian (played by An Zhi Jie), in prison. Ashan approaches Atian, gains his trust, and collects evidence against the criminal group. After both of them are released from prison, Ashan assists Atian in rising within the criminal organization in Hong Kong. After enduring numerous challenges, Atian successfully replaces the group's leader, Bao Ge (played by Zeng Zhiwei), becoming the new boss and taking control of the organization. However, just as Ashan is about to complete his mission, his true identity is exposed.

programme.title: Turns We Take
programme.desc: A spicy hot pot restaurant in Northeast China serves different types of customers every day. Amongst them are a sweet young couple, two wayward young men and a taxi driver. Despite being complete strangers to each other, their lives are intertwined by a traffic accident…

programme.title: Iceman: The Time Traveler
programme.desc: The imperial guard and his three traitorous childhood friends ordered to hunt him down get accidentally buried and kept frozen in time. 400 years later pass and they are defrosted continuing the battle they left behind.

programme.title: Prince Charming
programme.desc: Chen Li Pin, the nerdy son of a business tycoon, and his friend seek love in Hawaii. Returning home in disappointment, they accidentally find themselves in a messy identity swap.

programme.title: Blind War
programme.desc: Former SWAT captain Dong Gu suffers traumatic visual loss during a failed mission. But his nemesis appears and puts his daughter in danger. Dong Gu must fight to save his daughter.

programme.title: Black Bag
programme.desc: Seorang agen intelijen dicurigai mengkhianati negara, memaksa suaminya yang seorang agen untuk memilih antara kesetiaan pada pernikahannya atau negaranya.

programme.title: The Man from U.N.C.L.E.
programme.desc: Napoleon Solo, seorang agen CIA, dan Illya Kuryakin, seorang agen KGB, harus mengesampingkan perbedaan mereka dan bekerja sama untuk menggagalkan rencana organisasi kriminal yang ingin menggunakan senjata nuklir.

programme.title: First Love
programme.desc: The story is described as a poignant look at a young man's difficult entry into adulthood.

programme.title: Force Of Execution
programme.desc: A crime boss who runs a southwestern town needs the help of his former hit-man to deal with a new threat to his empire.

programme.title: The Fourth State
programme.desc: A German journalist investigating the Russian secret service gets caught up in a terrorist plot in Moscow.

programme.title: Another Mother's Son
programme.desc: Lou lives on the Nazi-occupied Island of Jersey during World War 2. She accepts to hide a young Russian POW at her house at the risk of being imprisoned herself and takes care of him as if he was her own son.

programme.title: Stowaway
programme.desc: A tenacious party girl fights to survive after three thieves commandeer her luxury yacht. Unable to escape, she turns the tables on the intruders and takes matters into her own hands.

programme.title: The Devil's Tomb
programme.desc: An elite group of soldiers on a covert mission to retrieve a scientist from an underground lab encounter an ancient evil in the facility.

programme.title: The Last Champion
programme.desc: When his mother dies, scandal-ridden ex-Olympian John Wright returns to a hometown that has not forgiven him.

programme.title: Skin
programme.desc: A destitute young man, raised by racist skinheads and notorious among white supremacists, turns his back on hatred and violence to transform his life, with the help of a black activist and the woman he loves.

programme.title: American Sicario
programme.desc: American gangster Erik Vasquez is scheming to become the top dog in the Mexican underworld, only to find himself making enemies out of both the powerful cartels and his own allies.

programme.title: Kill Craft
programme.desc: Marina lives with her disabled mother and her hit man father. When he dies at work, she must take charge of the family business and take care of her mother. Marked to die, Marina must navigate the world of assassins to survive.

programme.title: The Journey Is The Destination
programme.desc: Photographer Dan Eldon, was only 22 when he was killed by an angry mob in Somalia. He left behind 17 scrapbooks that held his art, chronicling his life from age 14.

programme.title: No Visitors
programme.desc: Respected surgeon Lewis Cutterman hides a dark secret. His family drugs guests and slowly consumes them, harvesting organs to sell for desperate patients in a twisted family business.

programme.title: Road To Hell
programme.desc: A soldier who has been fighting a long war is driven mad because he no longer believes in any purpose or righteous truth behind the killing. He comes home to a surreal world looking for his first and only love from his youth, believing she will rescue him from his demons. On the road to Edge City he encounters two seductive spree killers who oppose his efforts to find his love and the redemption he desperately seeks.

programme.title: Mythica: A Quest For Heroes
programme.desc: The young magician Marek meets the help-seeking priestess Teela. She offers her assistance and provides a motley troupe to go in search of Teela's sister, who was kidnapped by a wild ogre.

programme.title: Clean
programme.desc: Tormented by his past, a garbage man named Clean attempts a quiet life of redemption. But, soon finds himself forced to reconcile with the violence of his past.

programme.title: War Pigs
programme.desc: A ragtag unit of misfits known as the War Pigs must go behind enemy lines to exterminate Nazis by any means necessary.

programme.title: The Company You Keep
programme.desc: After a journalist discovers his identity, a former Weather Underground activist goes on the run.

programme.title: The Pig Farmer
programme.desc: Award-winning investigation into the crimes of Robert Pickton. This documentary explores why it took so many years to capture and convict Canada's most prolific serial killer. Troubling revelations about who knew what, and when.

programme.title: You're Not Alone
programme.desc: An evil entity begins to torment a mother and daughter, who are forced to face the inexplicable presence that inhabits the walls of their new home.

programme.title: A Street Cat Named Bob
programme.desc: A stray ginger cat changes the life of James Bowen, a homeless London street musician and recovering drug addict.

programme.title: The Price We Pay
programme.desc: After a pawn shop robbery goes askew, two criminals take refuge at a remote farmhouse to try to let the heat die down, but find something much more menacing.

programme.title: A Tale Of Two Guns
programme.desc: In the lawless West, a notorious brotherhood of killers and thieves called The Cowboys reigns over the land with brutal fists and fast guns. Fate finally catches up with them.

programme.title: Empire State
programme.desc: Two childhood friends plan to rob an armoured car depository, but an NYPD officer stands in their way.

programme.title: Play Dead
programme.desc: Chloe fakes her own death to steal evidence from a morgue. The Coroner uses the morgue as a front for a sick and twisted business. Then, Chloe learns more about the dead than she bargains for.

programme.title: Beneath Us
programme.desc: The American Dream becomes a nightmare for a group of undocumented day laborers hired by a wealthy couple.

programme.title: Among The Shadows
programme.desc: A private investigator must unravel the murder of her uncle while keeping the secret that she is a descendant from a line of werewolves.

programme.title: The Devil's Tomb
programme.desc: An elite group of soldiers on a covert mission to retrieve a scientist from an underground lab encounter an ancient evil in the facility.

programme.title: Armed Response
programme.desc: A remote facility, built as a prison with a secret super lie detector, is compromised and the five guarding it are possibly dead. An armed team of six investigates what's wrong.

programme.title: The Courier
programme.desc: A specialist carrier is hired to deliver a mysterious case to the underworld's most dangerous hitman.

programme.title: Ultraman Arc

programme.title: Superbook
programme.desc: Animasi Religi Kristen Yang Menceritakan Petualangan Seru Chris Dan Joy, Bersama Robot Mereka Gizmo. Melalui Sebuah Alat Bernama Superbook, Mereka Bertiga Mampu Menjelajah Lorong Waktu, Bertemu Dengan Tokoh-Tokoh Alkitab, Dan Menjadi Saksi Mata Sejarah. Melalui Petualangan Mereka Inilah, Superbook Membawa Pesan Alkitab Kepada Generasi Anak-Anak Di Era Digital.

programme.title: New Kongsuni & Friends
programme.desc: Kisah Seorang Gadis Kecil Berumur 5 Tahun Yang Senang Sekali Berpetualangan. Menurutnya Hidup Adalah Kisah Petualangan Yang Besar Dan Indah. Ia Selalu Berpetualangan Di Mana Saja, Di Rumah, Di Sekolah, Atau Di Taman Bermain.

programme.title: Metal Cardbot
programme.desc: Dahulu Kala, Terdapat Sebuah Planet Bernama Machina Dimana Metal Cardbots Tinggal. Suatu Ketika, Planet Ini Tiba-Tiba Meledak Dan Memaksa Semua Penghuninya Untuk Hidup Di Bumi. Agar Tidak Menarik Perhatian Makhluk Bumi, Cardbots Menyamar Sebagai Kendaraan Sehari-Hari. Hingga Suatu Hari, Seorang Anak Sekolah Dasar Yang Bernama Jun Secara Tidak Sengaja Menemukan Metal Breath, Dengan Metal Breath Tersebut Dia Bisa Menangkap Dan Menyalakan Cardbots Dengan Kemampuan Yang Berbeda.

programme.title: Hunter X Hunter
programme.desc: Kisah Hunter x Hunter Berfokus Pada Seorang Anak Laki-Laki Bernama Gon Freecss, Yang Suatu Hari Menemukan Bahwa Ayahnya Yang Selama Ini Diberitahu Telah Meninggal, Masih Hidup Dan Sehat. Dia Mengetahui Bahwa Ayahnya, Ging Freecss, Adalah Seorang Hunter Legendaris. Terlepas Dari Kenyataan Bahwa Ayahnya Meninggalkan Gon Bersama Kerabatnya Untuk Mengejar Mimpinya, Gon Bertekad Untuk Mengikuti Jejak Ayahnya, Lulus Ujian Hunter, Dan Akhirnya Menemukan Ayahnya Untuk Membuktikan Dirinya Sebagai Hunter Dengan Haknya Sendiri.

programme.title: Gavan Infinity
programme.desc: Menceritakan Kisah Reiji Doki, Penyelidik Polisi Federal Galaksi, Yang Mengemban Gelar Space Sheriff Gavan. Ia Menyelidiki Emorgear Energi Kehidupan Yang Bereaksi Terhadap Emosi Negatif Guna Menghentikan Ancaman Kriminal Lintas Dimensi Yang Dapat Meruntuhkan Multiverse

programme.title: Yaiba - Samurai Legend
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Petualangan Tetsuha (Kurogane Yaiba) , Seorang Anak Laki-Laki Yang Dibesarkan Di Hutan. Ia Bercita-Cita Menjadi Samurai Sejati, Dan Perjalanannya Membawanya Keluar Dari Hutan Ke Kota Yang Ramai . Di Sana, Yaiba Bertemu Kawan Maupun Lawan, Serta Harus Menghadapi Berbagai Kekuatan Kuno.

programme.title: Cai Yoo (Cerita Anak Indonesia Yoo Yoo Yoo)
programme.desc: Program Hiburan Yang Edukatif Yang Disajikan Bagi Penonton Anak-Anak, Dipandu Oleh Seorang Host Yang Akan Mendatangi Sekolah-Sekolah Untuk Mengajak Siswa Bermain Sambil Belajar Bersama. Program Ini Akan Menampilkan Praktik Sains Dari Kakak Ilmuwan, Pertunjukan Dongeng, Hingga Pertunjukan Bakat Siswa Seperti Menyanyi, Menari, Berolahraga, Dll. Pada Setiap Bagian Program Terdapat Pembelajaran Bagi Siswa Yang Dikemas Lebih Menyenangkan.

programme.title: Abrakadabra

programme.title: Nailoong Vs Bombloong

programme.title: We Bare Bears Iii
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Kehidupan Tiga Saudara Beruang: Grizzly, Panda, Dan Ice Bear. Mereka Berusaha Keras Untuk Berintegrasi Dengan Masyarakat Manusia Di San Francisco Bay Area, Seperti Mencari Makan, Berteman, Atau Menjadi Populer Di Internet

programme.title: Smurfs
programme.desc: Sebuah Intro Baru Dibuat Untuk Musim Ini. Pertama, Voltaire Tiba Dan Menjatuhkan Brainy , Papa Smurf , Smurfette , Dan Handy Dari Layar. Ketiganya Menunggangi Punggungnya Saat Ia Melewati Penduduk Desa, Petani , Koki , Dan Hefty . Papa Smurf, Smurfette, Dan Brainy Jatuh Dari Voltaire, Yang Diberi Buah Beri Oleh Lily . Sementara Itu, Baby Dan Monkey Menunggangi Diaper Daddy Dengan Gembira. Kemudian, Adegan Beralih Ke Willow , Yang Sedang Melihat Ke Dalam Bola Kristalnya Dan Merasakan Kehadiran Dua Gadis Smurf , Bubble Dan Firefly , Yang Berada Di Gubuk Gargamel, Salah Satunya Bercahaya Dan Yang Lainnya Memiliki Kepang. Wild Kemudian Digunakan Sebagai Transisi Ke Desa, Dan Layar Penutup Menampilkan Papa Smurf, Smurfette, Brainy, Jokey , Hefty, Clumsy Dan Dimwitty (Sebagai Anggota Pemadam Kebakaran), Blossom , Storm , Wild, Bubble Dan Firefly.

programme.title: Super Wings
programme.desc: Jett Dan Teman-Temannya, Super Wings, Terus Menghadapi Tantangan Baru Di Setiap Pengiriman. Mereka Harus Bekerja Sama Untuk Memecahkan Masalah Dengan Menggunakan Keahlian Unik Mereka. Pada Musim Ini Jett Memiliki Perubahan Pada Tenaga Supernya Yaitu Menggunakan Mesin Listrik! Memiliki Desain Futuristic Dan Lebih Ramping Dari Sebelumnya, Mereka Dibuat Seperti Itu Agar Sesuai Dengan Konsep Listrik Baru Dan Mereka Juga Menyambut Energi Terbaru Yang Bersih Dan Ramah Lingkungan.

programme.title: Papa Pipi
programme.desc: Papa Pipi Adalah Sebuah Acara Animasi Kekeluargaan Yang Mengisahkan Tentang Papa Zola Dan Anak Perempuannya, Pipi Zola. Bersama-Sama Mereka Menjalani Petualangan Cilik Yang Terkadang Menjadi Lebih Menantang Dalam Kehidupan Mereka.

programme.title: Mechamato
programme.desc: Animasi Yang Menceritakan Seorang Anak Laki-Laki Bernama Amato Dalam Menemukan Sebuah Pesawat Ruang Angkasa Penjara Berisi Robot-Robot Jahat Yang Telah Jatuh Ke Bumi. Salah Satu Robot Tersebut Adalah Mechabot Yang Memiliki Kemampuan Untuk Mengubah Objek Sehari-Hari Menjadi Perangkat Berteknologi Tinggi. Amato Berhasil Menginovasi Mechabot Menjadi Master Mechabot. Sejak Itu, Mechabot Dan Amato Mulai Bekerja Sama Untuk Menemukan Dan Menangkap Robot Jahat.

programme.title: Boonie Bears: Future Reborn
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Briar, Bramble, Dan Vick Terlempar Ke Masa Depan Pasca-Apokaliptik Di Mana Umat Manusia Terancam Punah Akibat Spora Jamur Mutan. Bersama Anak Laki-Laki Misterius, Mereka Berjuang Menyelamatkan Bumi Yang Hancur.

programme.title: Nice Goal
programme.desc: Nice Goal Mengisahkan Perjalanan Gao Feng, Seorang Pemain Muda Yang Berambisi Menjadi Pesepak Bola Profesional. Bersama Timnya, Ia Menghadapi Berbagai Pertandingan Kompetitif Yang Menguji Kemampuan, Strategi, Dan Kerja Sama Tim. Melalui Setiap Tantangan, Mereka Belajar Tentang Sportivitas, Disiplin, Dan Ketekunan Dalam Meraih Tujuan.

programme.title: The Tom & Jerry
programme.desc: Tom And Jerry Adalah Program Animasi Komedi Yang Berfokus Pada Persaingan Tanpa Henti Antara Seekor Kucing Bernama Tom Dan Seekor Tikus Cerdik Bernama Jerry. Setiap Episode Menampilkan Berbagai Upaya Tom Untuk Menangkap Jerry, Yang Selalu Berakhir Dengan Kegagalan Akibat Kecerdikan Jerry Dan Situasi-Situasi Tak Terduga.

programme.title: Boba (Bombastis Banget)
programme.desc: Boba (Bombastis Banget) Merupakan Program Yang Berisi Informasi Ringan Yang Menyajikan Video-Video Bombastis Yang Viral, Lucu, Dan Unik Dari Sosial Media. Bisa Berupa Video Kejadian Yang Tidak Biasa Ataupun Video Yang Sedang Viral. Video-Video Tersebut Akan Dikomentari Dengan Menggunakan Vo (Voice Over) Dan Dikemas Dengan Editing Yang Kekinian.

programme.title: Check In (Check Informasi)
programme.desc: Program Yang Menyajikan Fakta-Fakta Unik Tentang Fenomena Serta Isu Terkini Yang Terjadi Di Dunia Melalui Video-Video Yang Bersumber Dari Media Sosial Dan Dipaparkan Oleh Voice Over (Vo) Yang Unik. Check In Juga Akan Mengajak Interaksi Dengan Masyarakat Melalui Voxpop Tentang Tema Yang Dibahas.

programme.title: Obral (Obrolan Viral)
programme.desc: Obral (Obrolan Viral) Merupakan Program Informasi Yang Dipandu Oleh Dua Host Untuk Menyajikan Berita Terkini, Video Viral Dan Membahas Hal-Hal Unik Yang Dibicarakan Publik Secara Santai Dan Unik Dengan Format Semi Podcast Ala Radio Show.

programme.title: Zankuro
programme.desc: Kisah Seorang Ronin Bernama Zankuro, Samurai Pengembara Yang Hidup Di Zaman Edo. Meski Dikenal Sebagai Pendekar Pedang Yang Tak Terkalahkan, Zankuro Memiliki Sisi Lembut Dan Menjunjung Tinggi Keadilan. Dalam Perjalanannya, Ia Terlibat Dalam Berbagai Konflik Yang Menguji Prinsip, Harga Diri Dan Tanggung Jawabnya Sebagai Seorang Samurai Tanpa Tuan.

programme.title: Kokom (Kompilasi Komedi)

programme.title: Movinesia
